title: Expedition Complete
text: The hollow is mapped and the cellar is open. Its map points south-west, to a crater a long way off. Whatever we build here stays, and stays out of sight.

choices.label: Return to Touchdown
choices.reply: The convoy goes out by the east gap, the easy way, and turns for home.

choices.label: Stay a while
choices.reply: The expedition stays. The Command Core can take us home whenever we're ready.
